name: ui-consumes-sdk-module
description: UI consuming an SDK module: list the specific files in src/ui/tsconfig.app.json include (like ../core/wire.ts), never the whole ../client dir — config-file.ts imports node:fs and breaks the DOM-lib composite build. Keep the SDK module's transitive closure on src/core/* only (ndjson.ts types its envelope against core/wire.ts ErrorEnvelope, not client/types.ts).

content: Renames must update: (1) src/ui-tests which read page files by name string (capability-layer.test.ts, lifecycle-poll-fallback.test.ts, ready-plans-tab.test.ts, plot-surface-removed.test.ts), and (2) the noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity override in biome.jsonc, which is keyed by path. Component identifiers stay PascalCase; only filenames change.

title: UI revamp planned as pl-7e38: Direction C operator console
rationale: Shell-first in-place rebuild beats a greenfield second UI package (bundle ratchet and dead-code guards would fight a parallel tree) and beats a token reskin (Direction C changes the IA). Forward-chained DAG keeps independent pages dispatchable while component-reuse pairs stay sequential.
